title: Twin Tongues, Twin Targets
description: Layered fragments of printed ephemera, engineering schematics, and cut paper cover a black ground, anchored by horizontal warplane line drawings overlaid with vertical red-and-yellow bands. Four gold compact discs, two archery targets, mirrored Rolling Stones tongue-and-lip logos, an Arsenal badge, and an American football distribute across the composition alongside photographic sports imagery and metallic foil.
composition: wide horizontal panorama with twin tongue anchors
dimensions_source: cd-reference: 3 CDs measured (291.4/291.4/295.8px dia, 1.5% spread), mean 292.9px = 62.05px/in, applied to 2800x2119 native. Verified 2026-08-03.
